future_check: If authority precedence changes, rerun selected exact sync and execution parity before deciding whether the archival raw source must be synchronized.
rationale: The selected sources share rule hash ae8cc57061a0 and cross-source execution parity passes. Editing the longer raw source only to remove textual divergence would create unnecessary authority churn without changing semantics.
summary: No Racket patch is proposed; canonical program_solution and selected target_code are exact, while the longer raw_code remains explicitly archival.

future_check: Intake should replay the battery normally and verify that every finished stage has exit 0 without parent-signal recovery.
rationale: The execution environment interrupted the outer shell near its own time boundary while the child stage completed and wrote a valid receipt. Reporting both facts avoids treating a launcher artifact as a generator failure.
summary: The battery child stages completed, but one launcher journal row records parent_signal_exit 143 and recovery from the child receipt.

future_check: Re-run the linked census after any schedule change and keep exact count-backed strict support above the declared 0.40 floor in every band.
rationale: A 50% canonical-like schedule keeps the authored visual language prominent without returning to the original narrow 2x2-only support. The generalized profiles add larger bboxes, repeated colors, and difficulty-scaled component counts.
summary: Two of four deterministic sample-index profiles preserve exact canonical linked morphology while two broaden the rule-relevant distribution.

future_check: Consider a lesson-level seeded permutation that preserves one instance of each profile in the first four demonstrations; stop if it breaks query support or exact reproducibility.
rationale: The deterministic cadence guarantees that four demonstrations expose all required semantic branches, but a learner with position leakage could exploit the profile order. Colors, placements, orientations, and path shapes still vary by seed.
summary: The four-profile schedule is keyed to sample_index modulo four, so profile family is predictable from sequence position.

future_check: After morphology edits, require at least one interior-deletion witness and one missing-border witness in every five-pair lesson and in each 200-draw band census.
rationale: The original 2x2 L-only distribution made bbox outline identical to filling the bbox, so a fill-box shortcut solved every ordinary example. Larger sparse paths force border addition and interior deletion, which distinguishes the actual rule.
summary: The default curriculum intentionally includes both missing bbox-border cells and interior input cells.

future_check: Keep RULE_HASH, module docstring, SUMMARY, and rule_mirror synchronized whenever the selected task rule changes.
rationale: All four canonical pairs and both selected Racket authorities implement per-object bbox outlines. No output recolors cells by neighbor count.
summary: The former touch-degree recoloring description was unrelated to the executable authority and was removed.
